$comment: gachaEnabled=false means MARKETPLACE-ONLY: spec §3 [FIX H6] forbids launching real-money gacha or
buyback on a chain without Chainlink VRF v2.5. The commit-reveal fallback (§5.3.6) stays documented
and disabled. The deploy script reads this file and refuses to deploy the GachaMachine where
permit2=null selects PaymentRouter's allowance fallback path.
confirmations are set ABOVE each chain's observed reorg depth (spec §8.4 FIX L5-backend).
callbackGasLimit is 200000: measured worst case is 38554 (MAX_RIPS_PER_TX draws in one callback,
pinned by test/unit/CallbackGas.t.sol), so this is ~5x headroom. Do NOT raise it 'to be safe' —
Chainlink reserves maxGasPrice x callbackGasLimit from the subscription BEFORE accepting a
request, and each gas lane has its own max price. At the old 2500000 the reserve was 0.075 ETH on
Base's 30 gwei lane and 1.81 ETH on Sepolia's 500 gwei lane, which parked every Sepolia request as
'pending, insufficient balance' with no error on-chain.

chains.name: Anvil Devnet
chains.note: Local devnet, deployed by script/DeployLocal.s.sol with a mock VRF coordinator and a zero-delay Timelock. Never a real chain.

chains.name: Base Sepolia
chains.vrfNote: The 30 gwei lane, and the only lane Base Sepolia publishes. This entry previously carried Arbitrum One's 2 gwei hash (0x9e9e4673…a38897) — verified wrong on 2026-07-29 by a live request that the coordinator rejected with 'Invalid key hash'. A wrong hash is accepted by the contract and by the coordinator's request call, then never fulfilled, so the only symptom is a draw that hangs until refundStuckRip. Re-verify any hash you change against docs.chain.link rather than against another chain's entry.
chains.payTokenNote: cUSD is our own FaucetStablecoin (src/testing/FaucetStablecoin.sol), 6 decimals. mint() is PUBLIC and unrestricted, which is how both testers and the reserve are funded — so supply here is unlimited and the reserve's size proves the mechanism, not any backing. The token also has a claim() with a 24h cooldown; it bounds nothing while mint() is open, so the UI does not present it as a limit. Listed FIRST because the code takes the first payTokens entry as the default. A pool version records its own payToken, so switching tokens is a new pool commit plus setAllowedPayToken — never a redeploy, but it DOES orphan the previously committed pool. The constructor refuses to exist on a production chain id.

faucet.note: Dispensed by the token's unrestricted mint(), not by claim(). claim() exists and enforces 500 per address per 24h, but mint() is public on this token so that cooldown bounds nothing — presenting it as a limit would be false. Anyone can mint any amount up to 100M; that is deliberate on a testnet and is exactly why the contract refuses to deploy to a production chain id.

chains.name: Ethereum Sepolia
chains.vrfNote: Sepolia publishes a single 500 gwei gas lane, so there is no lane choice to make here. nativePayment=true means the subscription is funded with Sepolia ETH (24% premium) rather than LINK (20%); fund it with ETH or this flips to LINK and requests revert as underfunded.
chains.note: Rehearsal chain for the live VRF round-trip. Ethereum Sepolia is NOT a proxy for Base or BNB economics — L1 gas and VRF premiums differ by orders of magnitude — so treat a pass here as proof the Chainlink integration works, not as proof the product is affordable.

chains.name: BNB Chain Testnet
chains.vrfNote: Single 50 gwei lane. nativePayment=true mirrors the mainnet `bnb` entry so the rehearsal exercises the same path — which means the subscription must hold tBNB. A LINK balance is NOT used while this flag is true; flip it to false to spend LINK instead (50% premium vs 60% for native on this chain).

chains.name: Robinhood Chain
chains.marketplaceOnlyReason: Chainlink VRF v2.5 is not deployed on Robinhood Chain (verified against docs.chain.link/vrf/v2-5/supported-networks, 2026-07-29 — the chain is not listed). Spec §3 [FIX H6] forbids real-money gacha or buyback without VRF, so this deployment ships Marketplace + CollectibleNFT only. Set gachaEnabled=true and fill in the vrf block if and when a VRF v2.5 coordinator is deployed there.
chains.permit2Note: Not documented as deployed on Robinhood Chain. PaymentRouter's ERC-20 allowance fallback covers this; re-check before launch, because Permit2 is deterministic and may be deployed later.
chains.payTokenNote: USDG (Global Dollar), from the canonical list at docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts. There is NO canonical USDC on this chain — do not reuse an Ethereum USDC address. Confirm USDG is the intended settlement asset before launch: it is a different issuer from USDC and carries its own redemption and counterparty terms.
chains.moonpayNote: MoonPay does not list Robinhood Chain as a supported delivery network. Users fund by bridging in, so the fiat on-ramp is unavailable here. Verify with MoonPay before promising card purchase on this chain.
chains.rpcNote: Public endpoint is shared and rate limited — Robinhood documents it for wallet connectivity and testing, not production traffic. Use a dedicated provider (Alchemy exposes robinhood-mainnet) for the indexer and relayer.
chains.stack: Arbitrum Orbit L2, ETH for gas, Ethereum blobs for data availability. Mainnet opened 2026-07-01.
